body:
WHAT
- U-06: a live reasoning block is a <details> without open, so it is collapsed by default; the tool row that ends it and the answer after it are siblings of the block, never inside it. Nothing in the code opens it (checked: no open attribute, no CSS forcing it) — the field screenshot shows a block the owner opened by hand. Its summary counts time and size (long-silent-work-stays-visible).
- U-08: a retry_status frame shows "<reason> — retrying in <n>s (attempt <k>)" on the now-line (the shared strip, and a tiled pane's own strip). Unchanged code: the field run could not show it only because of the T01 backlog.
- U-09: .stream sets overflow-wrap: anywhere, so a long unbroken line in a sys note, an error, a task subject or any text wraps instead of widening #transcript; code blocks and tables keep their own horizontal scroll (white-space: pre does not wrap). Reproduced first: a 600-character command_output or error line gave #transcript a scrollWidth of 3,753 / 4,908 against a clientWidth of 1,521; a long tool row, reasoning word, inline code, URL, heading, code block or table did not.
- U-09: shortModelLabel() keeps the last path segment ("accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p3" → "glm-5p3"); every option carries the full id as its title; applyModel() adds a configured model the list does not know as its own option instead of selecting "Custom…" over a text box that showed only "accounts/fireworks/models/".

WHY
Field test 2026-09-23, findings U-06, U-08, U-09: "I still see all outputs at reasoning part"; HTTP 429 retries up to attempt 4 that the user never saw; a horizontal scroll bar under the conversation; the model field showing accounts/fireworks/models/ and the preset list "Custom…".

WHERE
app/renderer/modules/stream.js createReasoningEl(); app/renderer/modules/landing.js the retry_status case; app/renderer/styles.css .stream; app/renderer/modules/session.js shortModelLabel(), applyModel(), onModelCatalog().

TEST CHECKLIST
1. (ui) A live reasoning block is closed; the tool row that ends it and the next answer are outside it.
2. (ui) A retry_status frame puts reason, delay and attempt on the now-line, single console and a tiled pane.
3. (ui) A 600-character unbroken command_output line and error line leave #transcript's scrollWidth equal to its clientWidth.
4. (ui) With the model accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p3 and no catalog, the picker's selected option reads glm-5p3, carries the full id as its title, and the Custom box stays hidden.
